candidates.label: One revelation-mode shared by Muhammad and the messengers before him
candidates.definition: In 42:3: Thus has He revealed to you and to those before you, Allah the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

evidence.excerpt: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِيٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Angelic praise and forgiveness-seeking for earth-dwellers beneath straining heavens
candidates.definition: In 42:5: The heavens almost break from above them and the angels exalt with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth; unquestionably it is Allah who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

evidence.excerpt: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِن فَوۡقِهِنَّۚ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ لِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Warning addressed to the Mother of Cities and its surroundings
candidates.definition: In 42:7: Thus We revealed to you an Arabic Quran that you may warn the Mother of Cities and those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly about which there is no doubt; a party in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.

evidence.excerpt: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡجَمۡعِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ فَرِيقٞ فِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٞ فِي ٱلسَّعِيرِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Referral of every disputed matter to divine ruling with reliance and return
candidates.definition: In 42:10: And in anything over which you disagree its ruling is to be referred to Allah; that is Allah my Lord, upon Him I have relied and to Him I turn back.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفۡتُمۡ فِيهِ مِن شَيۡءٖ فَحُكۡمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّي عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَإِلَيۡهِ أُنِيبُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Negation of any likeness to Him following the making of mates
candidates.definition: In 42:11: Creator of the heavens and the earth; He made for you from yourselves mates and among the cattle mates, multiplying you thereby; there is nothing like unto Him and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

evidence.excerpt: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ أَزۡوَٰجٗا يَذۡرَؤُكُمۡ فِيهِۚ لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهِۦ شَيۡءٞۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: One religion ordained across five named prophets with the charge to establish and not divide
candidates.definition: In 42:13: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and what We revealed to you and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus, to establish the religion and not be divided therein; difficult for the associators is that to which you invite them; Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back.

evidence.excerpt: ۞شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحٗا وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ وَمَا وَصَّيۡنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓۖ أَنۡ أَقِيمُواْ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُواْ فِيهِۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مَا تَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجۡتَبِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ مَن يُنِيبُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Division arising after knowledge out of jealous animosity
candidates.definition: In 42:14: They did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them, out of jealous animosity between themselves; and if not for a word that preceded from your Lord until a specified time it would have been concluded between them.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٞ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى لَّقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لَفِي شَكّٖ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيبٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Commanded straight course with justice, shared lordship and separated deeds
candidates.definition: In 42:15: So to that invite and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say I have believed in what Allah revealed and I have been commanded to do justice among you; Allah is our Lord and your Lord, for us our deeds and for you your deeds, there is no argument between us and you, Allah will bring us together and to Him is the destination.

evidence.excerpt: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَٱدۡعُۖ وَٱسۡتَقِمۡ كَمَآ أُمِرۡتَۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۖ وَقُلۡ ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَٰبٖۖ وَأُمِرۡتُ لِأَعۡدِلَ بَيۡنَكُمُۖ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمۡۖ لَنَآ أَعۡمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلُكُمۡۖ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمُۖ ٱللَّهُ يَجۡمَعُ بَيۡنَنَاۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: The Book sent in truth together with the balance
candidates.definition: In 42:17: It is Allah who has sent down the Book in truth and also the balance; and what will make you perceive, perhaps the Hour is near.

evidence.excerpt: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَۗ وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Two harvests contrasted with increase reserved for the Hereafter-seeker
candidates.definition: In 42:20: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter, We increase for him in his harvest; and whoever desires the harvest of this world, We give him thereof but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.

evidence.excerpt: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرۡثَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ نَزِدۡ لَهُۥ فِي حَرۡثِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرۡثَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا نُؤۡتِهِۦ مِنۡهَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Repentance accepted and misdeeds pardoned with answered supplication and added bounty
candidates.definition: In 42:25-26: It is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds and knows what you do; and He answers those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases for them from His bounty.

evidence.excerpt: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَقۡبَلُ ٱلتَّوۡبَةَ عَنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعۡفُواْ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَسۡتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦۚ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Provision measured because excess would produce tyranny across the earth
candidates.definition: In 42:27: And if Allah had extended provision excessively for His servants they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth, but He sends it down in an amount which He wills; indeed He is of His servants Acquainted and Seeing.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَلَوۡ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٖ مَّا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرُۢ بَصِيرٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Rain arriving after despair as the spreading of mercy
candidates.definition: In 42:28: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy, and He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.

evidence.excerpt: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡغَيۡثَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا قَنَطُواْ وَيَنشُرُ رَحۡمَتَهُۥۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡوَلِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Disaster traced to earned deeds while much is pardoned
candidates.definition: In 42:30: And whatever strikes you of disaster, it is for what your hands have earned, but He pardons much.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَآ أَصَٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٖ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتۡ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَيَعۡفُواْ عَن كَثِيرٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Mountain-like ships and stillable wind as signs for the patient and grateful
candidates.definition: In 42:32-33: And of His signs are the ships in the sea like mountains; if He willed He could still the wind and they would remain motionless on its surface; indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

evidence.excerpt: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلۡجَوَارِ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: إِن يَشَأۡ يُسۡكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظۡلَلۡنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٖ شَكُورٍ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Lasting divine portion set against temporary worldly enjoyment
candidates.definition: In 42:36: So whatever thing you have been given, it is but enjoyment of the worldly life, but what is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely.

evidence.excerpt: فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَيۡءٖ فَمَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Consultation as the community's decision method alongside prayer and spending
candidates.definition: In 42:38: And those who have responded to their Lord and established prayer and whose affair is determined by consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them they spend.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَجَابُواْ لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَمۡرُهُمۡ شُورَىٰ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Proportionate retribution permitted while pardon and reconciliation carry divine reward
candidates.definition: In 42:40: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation, his reward is due from Allah; indeed He does not like wrongdoers.

evidence.excerpt: وَجَزَـٰٓؤُاْ سَيِّئَةٖ سَيِّئَةٞ مِّثۡلُهَاۖ فَمَنۡ عَفَا وَأَصۡلَحَ فَأَجۡرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Blame confined to those who wrong people and tyrannise without right
candidates.definition: In 42:41-42: And whoever avenges himself after having been wronged, those have not upon them any cause for blame; the cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannise upon the earth without right.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعۡدَ ظُلۡمِهِۦ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيۡهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظۡلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَيَبۡغُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Three exclusive modes of divine address to a human being
candidates.definition: In 42:51: And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger to reveal by His permission what He wills; indeed He is Most High and Wise.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحۡيًا أَوۡ مِن وَرَآيِٕ حِجَابٍ أَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ رَسُولٗا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذۡنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
